parameters.name: DagJson
parameters.description: The directed acyclic graph (DAG) of the workflow, including the information about the nodes and the edges. Specify the value of this parameter in the JSON format.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The application group ID. You can obtain the application group ID on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: NamespaceSource
parameters.description: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 update-workflow-dag --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --workflow-id 123 --dag-json nodes_:_id_:2300691_,_id_:10518089_,_id_:1758851_,_edges_:_source_:10518089,_target_:1758851_,_source_:10518089,_target_:2300691 --region cn-hangzhou
